subject: [PATCH bpf-next 2/3] bpf, cgroup: Don't attach to a removed cgroup

2026-11-12.patch_summary: This patch prevents a BPF program from being attached to a cgroup that has been removed, which could lead to a use-after-free error or a leaked program. The patch checks if the cgroup is dead under the lock before attempting to attach the program, and returns an error (-ENOENT) if it is. This fix addresses a race condition where the release work for the cgroup waits for the cgroup_mutex, making it easier to hit this issue. With this patch applied, attaching a link behind a slow mkdir operation will no longer result in a use-after-free error or a leaked program.
